sloka: सुग्रीवः स च रामेण निरन्तरमुरोगतः ।विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा सर्वे ते बाष्पविक्लवाः ।। ७.४०.२६ ॥
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ sa ca rāmeṇa nirantaramurogataḥ ।vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā sarve te bāṣpaviklavāḥ ।। 7.40.26 ॥

translations.english: Sugriva, who was constantly embraced by Rama, and the righteous Vibhishana, along with all the others, were overcome with tears.
